msg: Hi! I'd like to try the mini course this Saturday. What time do we get back to Cartagena? I have a flight to Bogotá at 7 pm that same day.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The mini-course is a lovely way to try diving in the Rosario Islands. From Cartagena, the boat returns at 3:00 p.m., with an estimated arrival around 4:15 p.m.

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Yes, from Cartagena. So I'll make my 7 pm flight to Bogotá, right? I'm British, just me.
reply:
The return to Cartagena is estimated at 4:15 p.m., so a 7:00 p.m. flight would leave you with a tight connection. Also, after the mini-course you need to wait at least 12 hours after your dive, which ends around noon, before flying. That means a 7:00 p.m. flight would be too soon. Please check with a team advisor about your travel plans.

🤿 *Dive Mini Course*
💰 *183 USD* per person (online rate)
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, boat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, pool training + 1 ocean dive with a PADI instructor, diving equipment, lunch and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿

msg: OK, I'll move my flight to Sunday then. Thanks!
